SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-02-2020 - CONTINUED FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE TO MAY-05-2020 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-02-2020 - PLAINTIFF FELICATAS BRAVO RAMIREZ, ASSISTED BY NINA SAFDIE, COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPERTER IS PRESENT. MARIO VILLANUEVA TESTIFIES ON PLAINTIFF'S BEHALF. DEFENDANTS JUAN G. ESCOBAR DBA GE TOWING REPRESENTED BY ALEJANDRA ARIAS, MANAGER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ROSARIO ESCOBAR DBA GE TOWING IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT FARID ABRAHAM VARGAS HAS NOT BEEN SERVED AND IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT ASKS FOR A CONTINUANCE TO TRY TO LOCATE AND HAVE DEFENDANT FARID ABRAHAM VARGAS APPEAR IN COURT. PLAINTIFF DOES NOT WISH TO CONTINUE THE HEARING DATE AND THE CASE IS CALLED. PLAINTIFF TESTIFIES THAT MUTIPLE ATTEMPTS TO REACH AND SERVE FARID ABRAHAM VARGAS HAVE BEEN UNSUCCESSFUL AND THAT HE CAN NOT BE FOUND. ALEJANDRA ARIAS TESTIFIES THAT THEY CAN NOT LOCATE THE NAMED DEFENDANT FARID ABRAHAM VARGAS. DOCUMENT REVIEW IS DONE IN OPEN COURT BETWEEN PARTIES. AN AUDIO RECORDING IS PLAYED AND TRANSLATED BY THE INTERPERTER IN OPEN COURT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS REVIEWED AND RETURNED. PLAINTIFF'S SUBMITED COPY OF AN INSURANCE CHECK FOR $6,592.88 IS GIVEN TO DEFENDANT BY THE COURT. COURT CONTINUES THIS MATTER TO MAY 4, 2020 AT 3:30 P.M. FOR FURTHER EVIDENCE. DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO PRODUCE MR. VARGAS AT THIS HEARING JUAN ESCOBAR IS ORDERED TO BE PRESENT AT THIS HEARING. IF THEY ARE NOT PRESENT JUDGMENT CAN BE ISSEUD AS TO DEFENDANTS. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
